content.rendered:
ZenCharge Slim Bamboo Wireless Charger

ZenCharge Slim is a beautifully crafted that doubles as a sleek workspace organizer. This eco-conscious 15W wireless charger features an integrated wireless charger with phone stand design plus a handy making it the ideal accessory for home offices, bedside tables, and corporate gifts.

Why choose ZenCharge Slim?

  • Fast, reliable charging: Supports up to 15W wireless charger speeds for compatible phones — fast enough for daily use while keeping devices upright on the built-in phone stand.
  • Sustainable materials: Made from responsibly sourced bamboo, the bamboo wireless charger gives your workspace a warm, natural look without sacrificing durability.
  • Organized workspace: The unique wireless charger with phone stand includes a double pen stand to keep pens, styluses and small desk items neat and accessible.
  • Universal compatibility: Qi-enabled devices charge effortlessly; the ZenCharge Slim is an excellent choice whether you need a single-purpose bamboo wireless charger or a compact desk hub.

Product description

The ZenCharge Slim combines form and function — a premium bamboo wireless charger with an ergonomic wireless charger angle that keeps your screen visible while charging. Its integrated  stores two pens or styluses, giving you a decluttered desktop. As a 15W wireless charger, it balances speed and safety with built-in temperature control and foreign object detection.

Key features

  • 15W wireless charging for fast top-up power.
  • Eco-friendly bamboo top with anti-slip rubber feet.
  • Integrated phone stand angle for video calls and notifications.
  • Built-in double pen stand for pens, styluses, and small tools.
  • Qi-compatible — works with most smartphones and earbuds cases.
  • Safety features: over-current, over-voltage, and temperature protection.
